- When sentiment is positive (≥0.25), model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% relative to prior period.
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., >+3% from prior day), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +2% above peak for next 3–5 days.
- Model underestimates mean-reversion zones; if 3 consecutive days show downward trend, add 0.3–0.7% upward bias to next forecast.
- For 30-day horizon, model consistently underestimates late-period (last 7–10 days) price increases; apply +0.5–1.0% bias to final 5–7 days.
- If sentiment is neutral or negative (≤0.00), model shows persistent underestimation; add 0.2–0.8% upward bias to forecast, especially if recent history is flat.
